title: Benching canonical run comparison (schema v1)
description: Portable comparison of independently analyzed runs. Embedded summaries are validated against the summary v1 contract by consumers (no cross-file $ref, so each file stays self-contained). Unknown extra fields are allowed and stripped by consumer projection, never rendered blindly.

schema_version.description: Major contract version. Only 1 is supported; future majors are classified unsupported, never parsed as v1.

comparison_id.description: Stable identity for this comparison document (filename stem). Optional so older artifacts stay valid.

run_ids.description: Must match the embedded summaries' run ids in order.

official_comparison.description: Sequential execution-protocol marker, not an endorsement of comparison fairness.

tokenizers_comparable.description: Whether cross-run local-token metrics may be compared. False covers both known-different and unknown identities.

tokenizer_identity_status.description: known_equal, known_different, or unknown (two missing identities are unknown, never proven equal). Optional so older artifacts stay valid.

runs.description: Embedded independent run summaries, each validated against the summary v1 contract.
